entry.title: [様子見] npm: Astro: Image endpoint in @astrojs/node can read files from a case-variant sibling of the output directory on case-sensitive filesystems (MEDIUM)
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：様子見 @astrojs/nodeの画像処理で隣のフォルダのファイルが読めるMEDIUM
→ astro 7.4.7に更新。@astrojs/nodeは修正版なし
